_review: Phase 9 D10–D11: the Long Walker's line, the Wellhouse camp and the three Silent Instruments (docs/phase-9/dunes-design.md §4). The side sites are still to come.
title: The Glass Dunes

npcs.name: Sarai
npcs.about: Keeps the Wellhouse well, though it has been dry longer than the caravan has been stranded.

npcs.name: Hesper
npcs.about: Caravan master. Brought the sledges this far and has no plan for getting them back.

npcs.name: Iven
npcs.about: Reads old battles in fused glass, the way others read weather.

npcs.name: Nadra
npcs.about: The caravan's mapmaker. Her map marks a cistern nobody has found.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.about: Nadra's child. Wants to see everything from higher up.

quests.title: Into the Erg
quests.summary: A stranded caravan holds the ruined caravanserai at the oasis, around a well with nothing in it.

steps.journal: Speak to Sarai by the dry well at the Wellhouse.
Free the caravan's sled behind the back wall. Sweep a channel beside it, then start the lip of the sand above: sand goes where the channel is cut.
Tell Sarai the sled is free.

quests.title: A Light
quests.summary: Sarai says the Walker followed the Shapers' instruments: a light, a clock and a song. The light is in the Red Galleries.

steps.journal: Find the Shapers' gate on the floor of the Red Galleries. The sun comes down the canyon: from one end in the morning, from the other after noon, and not at all at night.

quests.title: A Clock
quests.summary: The clock stands on the rim above the Needle, a Shaper thing that still moves.

steps.journal: Find the sand-clock on the rim above the Needle. Shaper sand never stops pouring. See where it goes, and where it should.

quests.title: A Song
quests.summary: Three crests of a star dune that boom when they slide, and a ring of stones between them.

steps.journal: Find the ring of stones on the great star dune, east of the Stride. The stones hum a phrase; the same phrase is cut into them. The crests answer when they slide.

quests.title: Follow the Glass
quests.summary: Footprints of glass, each as long as a house, cross the erg in a great loop. Something walked here, and the sand fused under it.

steps.journal: Follow the glass footprints across the erg. They lead toward the great star dune.

The Long Walker walks its old circuit. Make it stumble: change the ground where a foot will land — a Ridge under it, a Bloom's pit, or sand bound hard with Frost. Then climb its kneeling leg onto its back.
Steer the Long Walker home to the dry well at the Wellhouse, west round the Stride: a Shard against a glyph pillar on its back turns it to that side. At the well, light the shaft.

quests.title: The Mirage Map
quests.summary: Nadra's map marks a cistern that isn't there.

steps.journal: Ask Nadra about the cistern on her map.
Go to the salt pan's two cairns at noon, and take a bearing from each on the dome that shows there.
The bearings cross on the pan. Sweep the sand there away.

quests.title: The Sky Window
quests.summary: Pell wants to know what the window on the tallest hoodoo shows.

steps.journal: Ask Pell about the hoodoo.
Climb to the window on the tallest hoodoo, at the south end of the Galleries. Crystallize the falls: each stands as a stair for as long as the sun lets it.

quests.title: The Glass Battle
quests.summary: Iven reads five formations of fused glass as five moments of an old fight.

steps.journal: Hear Iven read the glass.
At each glass field, stand where the blow came from and give its element back. Iven said: east, north and west were frost; the south stone; the fifth, anything.
Go back to Iven.

quests.title: The Buried Door
quests.summary: The Sunken Temple's door, vent and stair lie under the sand.

steps.journal: Speak to Sarai about the temple.
Clear the temple's door, vent and stair with a Ridge. Every Ridge pushes sand somewhere, and what was cleared can be buried again.

quests.title: The Flood Garden
quests.summary: The restored wadi runs at dusk through a side canyon with four dry cisterns.

steps.journal: Speak to Sarai about the side canyon.
At dusk, fill all four cisterns in one flood: a Ridge dam, an ice dam, and a channel wet with Ribbon before it is cut.

sarai.sled.speaker: sarai
lines: You came out of the sand with no water and no thirst. I'm Sarai. I keep this well.
There's nothing in it to keep. But our best sled is buried behind the back wall, and that I can ask for.
That heap above it is ready to go. Touch the lip and it pours straight over the runners. Sand takes the lowest way it can find.
So give it one. Sweep a channel beside the sled first, then start the lip.

sarai.after.speaker: sarai
lines: It went where you cut it. Remember that. Most of this desert still will.
The well followed the Walker, and the Walker followed the Shapers' instruments: a light, a clock and a song.
Nothing has sounded in an age. Nadra has them on her map, for what her map is worth.

hesper.first.speaker: hesper
lines: Hesper. This is my caravan, what's left of it.
No beasts out here. We pull the sledges ourselves, and the best one is under a dune. Talk to Sarai.

hesper.after.speaker: hesper
lines: That sled has crossed more sand than I have. Thank you for it.

iven.first.speaker: iven
lines: Iven. I read glass.
Every print out on the erg was made in one step. You can tell which way the weight went by the splash.

nadra.first.speaker: nadra
lines: Nadra. I draw what's here, which is harder than it sounds. The dunes keep their shape now, and I don't trust it.
Sand that stops moving is not a thing I have a map for.

pell.first.speaker: pell
lines: Have you been on top of the wall? You can see the whole glass from up there. Mother says I can't.

sarai.light.speaker: sarai
lines: There was a line of light across the erg this morning. I've kept this well forty years and never seen it.
A clock and a song. Whichever you reach.

sarai.clock.speaker: sarai
lines: Hesper says the sand behind the wall moved in the night. On its own, the way it used to.
Keep going. Something out there has started listening.

sarai.song.speaker: sarai
lines: I felt that in the well stones. Low, then high, then the one between.
That's the Walker's own phrase. When you hear it again it won't be coming from the dunes.

sarai.woke.speaker: sarai
lines: So it's up. Bring it home. The well has waited longer than either of us.

hesper.clock.speaker: hesper
lines: Sand moving again. If that clock keeps time, I can plan a route for the first time since we stopped here.

nadra.after.speaker: nadra
lines: The light is on the floor of the Red Galleries. The clock is on the rim above the Needle. The song is out on the great star dune, past the Stride.
Any order. I've marked them, and I'd like them back unbroken.

iven.light.speaker: iven
lines: The beam left a mark on every print it crossed. I can read which way it went.
That gate was never for looking through. It was for pointing.

pell.song.speaker: pell
lines: I heard the dunes! Low, high, middle. Mother says I made it up. I didn't.

nadra.found.speaker: nadra
lines: It was there. Under where I drew it, not where it showed.
A mirage lies along the line you see it on, never at the end of it. I'm putting that on the map.

pell.window.speaker: pell
lines: You went up! Is it true you can see the sky through it? I'm making a kite. It's going to fly from there.

iven.done.speaker: iven
lines: Five blows, and you stood where each one started. I felt them from here.
Take this. I wove the beads from the fields. They've earned being worn by someone who has read them.

sarai.door.speaker: sarai
lines: The temple's door. I'd stopped believing it had one.

sarai.garden.speaker: sarai
lines: Four cisterns full. Do you know how long it's been since anyone here planted something?

nadra.mirage.speaker: nadra
lines: My map marks a cistern out on the salt pan, and nobody has ever found it. At noon you can see its dome, from those two cairns.
It isn't where it looks. Take the line from each cairn and see where they cross.

iven.battle.speaker: iven
lines: Five fused formations, five frozen moments of the old fight. The splash in the south field came from the east, and froze before it fell.
The next, from the north. The third from the west: all frost. The fourth from the south was stone. The fifth took anything.
Stand where the blow came from, and give it back. The glass will ring.

pell.falls.speaker: pell
lines: There's a window on the tallest hoodoo, at the south end of the Galleries. A sky window. Nobody will take me.
Falls run between the hoodoos there. Mother says frozen sand holds. In the sun it won't for long.

sarai.temple.speaker: sarai
lines: With Stone you could clear the temple's door. It lies under the sand, with its vent and its stair.
Mind where you push. Each thing you clear goes onto the next, the door toward the vent and the vent toward the stair.

sarai.flood.speaker: sarai
lines: The wadi runs in the side canyon at dusk now, for a minute or so. Four cisterns stand there, dry.
Hold it with a Ridge, a dam of ice and a channel. Wet the channel first or the dry sand will slump.

echo-dunes-keep.name: Echo of the Long Shade
echo-dunes-keep.effect: Frost on sand lasts 40% longer in the sun.
echo-dunes-keep.text: What is held in shade can be carried a little way into the light.

echo-dunes-ridge.name: Echo of the Standing Wave
echo-dunes-ridge.text: The sand was always a slow sea.

echo-dunes-run.name: Echo of the Long Stride
echo-dunes-run.effect: Sand-surf keeps its speed on flats.
echo-dunes-run.text: It walked here. You may run.
